+               0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,
+               0.014,0.0135,0.0135,0.0135,0.0135,0.0135,0.0135,0.0135,0.0135,
+               0.014,0.014,0.014,0.014,0.015,0.017,0.019],
+    },
+    {
+        "name": "upper cross stroke",
+        "px": [(430,399),(451,399),(472,397),(493,394),(512,390),(530,386),
+               (544,385),(554,388),(562,394)],
+        "z":  [0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.017,0.019],
+    },
+    {
+        "name": "lower cross stroke",
+        "px": [(429,520),(441,520),(460,518),(480,516),(500,513),(520,510),
+               (537,507),(550,506),(560,509)],
+        "z":  [0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.016,0.017,0.019],
+    },
+]
+
+# The last submitted target in the preparation phase was this staging pose.
+command_tip = STAGE.copy()
+
+
+def submit_xyz(points, spacing=0.002, note=""):
+    """Stream a continuous vertical-brush path, interpolated at <= spacing."""
+    global command_tip
+    rows = []
+    last = command_tip.copy()
+    for endpoint in points:
+        endpoint = np.asarray(endpoint, dtype=float)
+        distance = float(np.linalg.norm(endpoint - last))
+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(distance / spacing)))
+        for t in np.linspace(1.0 / n, 1.0, n):
+            xyz = last + t * (endpoint - last)
+            rows.append(np.r_[xyz, DOWN])
+        last = endpoint
+    if not rows:
+        return None
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(rows), dt=0.05, video="none", cameras=[], note=note)
+    command_tip = last
+    failures = sum(int(item.get("ik_failures", 0)) for item in result.meta.get("plan", []))
+    if failures:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failures during {note}: {failures}")
+    return result
+
+
+def dense_stroke(pixel_nodes, z_nodes, spacing=0.002):
+    """Interpolate the centerline and its press depth in paper coordinates."""
+    nodes = [paper_px(u, v, z) for (u, v), z in zip(pixel_nodes, z_nodes)]
+    dense = []
+    for a, b in zip(nodes[:-1], nodes[1:]):
+        n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b - a) / spacing)))
+        dense.extend(a + (b - a) * t for t in np.linspace(1.0 / n, 1.0, n))
+    return nodes, dense
+
+
+def draw_stroke(index, stroke):
+    nodes, path = dense_stroke(stroke["px"], stroke["z"])
+    start, end = nodes[0], nodes[-1]
+
+    # Travel above the sheet, then lower at the start.  Contact is one stroke.
+    submit_xyz([np.r_[start[:2], 0.10]], spacing=0.01, note=f"hover {stroke['name']}")
+    submit_xyz([np.r_[start[:2], 0.035], start], spacing=0.004,
+               note=f"lower {stroke['name']}")
+    submit_xyz(path, spacing=0.002, note=f"stroke {index}: {stroke['name']}")
+    submit_xyz([np.r_[end[:2], 0.10]], spacing=0.004, note=f"lift {stroke['name']}")
+    submit_xyz([STAGE], spacing=0.01, note=f"clear sheet after {stroke['name']}")
+
+    # Save an unobstructed record frame after each completed stroke.
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam", "side_cam"], video="none")
+    Image.fromarray(obs.last["canvas_cam"]).save(OUT / f"main-after-stroke-{index}.png")
+    print(stroke["name"], r.status())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    for i, stroke in enumerate(STROKES, 1):
+        draw_stroke(i, stroke)
